label: Automation
short: Something runs on its own because you built it once.
strong: Things run without you: a report, a triage, a sync. You built them once and they keep going.
edge: Find one thing you do every week by hand. Make it run on its own, then watch it for a month.
unmet: An automation is a job that runs on a schedule or a trigger with nobody starting it: a weekly digest, an inbox triage, a data sync.
